notes: life-story spec, Life_Event_File. Drafted by Claude Code on 2026-11-24; approved by the user on 2026-11-24 (「草稿核准」) in both languages (life-story Requirement 1.2). Triggers are code (src/game/life/events.ts); this file holds the texts, priorities, cooldowns and options. Placeholders are filled by the Template_Filler. Every option list starts with the option that keeps things as they are (Escape chooses it, Requirement 2.5).

text.en: {name} has lived in social housing in {district} for {years} years. {reason} The tenancy ends next quarter.
text.zh-Hant: {name}在{district}的社會住宅住了 {years} 年。{reason}租約下一季到期。

limit.en: This is the longest tenancy the city allows for general households (6 years).
limit.zh-Hant: 這是市府給一般戶的最長租期（6 年）。

income.en: At renewal the household income ({income} a year) is above the city's limit ({limit}).
income.zh-Hant: 續約時，家庭年所得（{income}）高於市府的門檻（{limit}）。

text.en: The closest to things as they are: the same district, at its market rent.
text.zh-Hant: 最接近原本的生活：同一區，照市場行情的房租。

title.en: Rent a home in another district…

text.en: Choose a district; the rent and commute of each are shown for both versions.
text.zh-Hant: 選一個區，每一區的房租和通勤都會列出兩個版本。

title.en: Apply for another social housing home

text.en: Only where the rules allow a new application. Until the result, {name} rents privately in the same district.
text.zh-Hant: 只有規定允許再申請時才有這個選項。結果出來之前，{name}先在同一區租屋。

text.en: Only for an origin in Taipei or New Taipei.
text.zh-Hant: 只有出身臺北或新北才有這個選項。

text.en: {name}'s rent subsidy of {amount} a month ends with the calendar year. Households apply again each year.
text.zh-Hant: {name}每月 {amount} 的租金補貼隨著年度結束。每年都要重新申請。

text.en: From next quarter {name} pays the full rent.
text.zh-Hant: 從下一季起，{name}付全額房租。

text.en: Both versions apply and draw the same number. The result comes with the brief.
text.zh-Hant: 兩個{name}都會申請，抽到同一個號碼，結果在季報公布。

title.en: The rent has taken more than 30 % of income for a year
title.zh-Hant: 房租已經連續一年超過收入的 30%

text.en: For four quarters the rent has taken more than 30 % of {name}'s household income; this quarter it is {rentBurden} %. 30 % is the line the game uses for rent stress (its source is in the City report).
text.zh-Hant: 連續四季，房租都超過{name}家庭收入的 30%；這一季是 {rentBurden}%。30% 是遊戲用來判斷房租壓力的線（來源在城市報告裡）。

text.en: Stay in {district}.
text.zh-Hant: 留在{district}。

text.en: Districts are listed from the lowest rent; the commute of each is shown too.
text.zh-Hant: 各區照房租由低到高排，也會列出通勤時間。

text.en: Only when the household is eligible this year.
text.zh-Hant: 只有今年符合資格時才有這個選項。

text.en: Only for an origin in Taipei or New Taipei.
text.zh-Hant: 只有出身臺北或新北才有這個選項。

text.en: {name}'s story in the two cities ends here, and the Ending is shown. The city game can go on.
text.zh-Hant: {name}在雙北的故事到這裡結束，接著顯示結局。城市的遊戲可以繼續。

text.en: {city} is letting social housing units this quarter. {name}'s household income ({income} a year) is below the city's limit of {limit}.
text.zh-Hant: {cityZh}這一季有社會住宅出租。{name}的家庭年所得（{income}）低於市府的門檻 {limit}。

text.en: Keep renting in {district}.
text.zh-Hant: 繼續在{district}租屋。

text.en: Both versions of {name} apply and draw the same lottery number. The result comes with the brief.
text.zh-Hant: 兩個{name}都會申請，抽到同一個號碼，結果在季報公布。

text.en: Households renting in {city} can apply for this year's rent subsidy. {name}'s income per person ({incomePerPerson} a month) is below the limit of {limit}.
text.zh-Hant: 在{cityZh}租屋的家庭可以申請今年的租金補貼。{name}家每人每月所得（{incomePerPerson}）低於門檻 {limit}。

text.en: Pay the full rent.
text.zh-Hant: 付全額房租。

text.en: Both versions apply and draw the same number. The result comes with the brief.
text.zh-Hant: 兩個{name}都會申請，抽到同一個號碼，結果在季報公布。

title.en: A NT$1,280 monthly pass goes on sale

text.en: From 16 April 2018 one monthly pass covers the MRT and buses of Taipei and New Taipei. {name} works in {work}. In 2016 about {share} % of commuters in {city} used public transport.
text.zh-Hant: 2018 年 4 月 16 日起，一張月票就能搭雙北的捷運和公車。{name}在{work}上班。2016 年{cityZh}約有 {share}% 的通勤者搭大眾運輸。

text.en: No transport line in the ledger (single fares and scooter costs are not modelled).
text.zh-Hant: 帳本裡不列交通費（單程票和機車的花費不在模型裡）。

text.en: From next quarter the pass price of each version, after its subsidy, is in the ledger.
text.zh-Hant: 從下一季起，帳本會列出兩個版本各自扣掉補貼後的月票價格。

text.en: The landlord offers a new lease at the current rent of the district. What does {name} do?
text.zh-Hant: 房東願意續約，租金照這一區現在的行情。{name}要怎麼做？

text.en: Stay in {district}.
text.zh-Hant: 留在{district}。

text.en: Choose a district; the rent and commute of each are shown for both versions.
text.zh-Hant: 選一個區，每一區的房租和通勤都會列出兩個版本。

text.en: Only for an origin in Taipei or New Taipei.
text.zh-Hant: 只有出身臺北或新北才有這個選項。

text.en: For four quarters {name}'s trip to work has taken more than 60 minutes each way; now it is {commute} minutes.
text.zh-Hant: 連續四季，{name}單程上班都超過 60 分鐘；現在是 {commute} 分鐘。

text.en: Stay in {district} and keep the job in {work}.
text.zh-Hant: 住在{district}，繼續在{work}上班。

text.en: Districts are listed from the shortest commute; the rent of each is shown too.
text.zh-Hant: 各區照通勤時間由短到長排，也會列出房租。

title.en: Look for a job closer to home…

text.en: Choose an occupation and a work district.
text.zh-Hant: 選一個職業和上班的區。

title.zh-Hant: 家裡的長輩需要更多照顧

text.en: {name}'s parent needs help in daily life. The household decides where the parent will live.
text.zh-Hant: {name}的長輩日常生活需要人幫忙。家裡要決定長輩住在哪裡。

text.en: The parent stays where they live; {name}'s household does not change.
text.zh-Hant: 長輩住在原本的地方，{name}的家庭不變。

text.en: The household grows by one; the home size and rent follow the household size.
text.zh-Hant: 家裡多一個人，房子大小和房租跟著家庭人數改變。

text.en: {name} is offered a job as {offerOccupation} in {offerDistrict}. Mean pay in that industry is {offerWage} a month in {year}.
text.zh-Hant: {name}得到一個在{offerDistrict}當{offerOccupation}的機會。這個行業 {year} 年的平均月薪是 {offerWage}。

text.en: Keep the job in {work}.
text.zh-Hant: 繼續在{work}的工作。

text.en: From this quarter {name} works in {offerDistrict}.
text.zh-Hant: 從這一季起，{name}在{offerDistrict}上班。

text.en: {name} has been seeing someone for a while. They talk about living together.
text.zh-Hant: {name}和一個人交往一段時間了，兩人聊到要不要住在一起。

text.en: {name}'s household does not change.
text.zh-Hant: {name}的家庭不變。

text.en: Describe the partner: any gender, an occupation and a work district.
text.zh-Hant: 設定伴侶：任何性別、職業和上班的區。

text.en: {name} and {partnerName} have lived together for {years} years. {lawFact}
text.zh-Hant: {name}和{partnerName}已經一起住了 {years} 年。{lawFact}

text.en: They keep living together as they are.
text.zh-Hant: 兩人照現在這樣一起生活。

text.en: Only where the law of the quarter allows it; the legal fact and its source are shown.
text.zh-Hant: 只有當時的法律允許時才有這個選項；會列出法律事實和來源。

text.en: {name}'s household talks about a child joining the family.
text.zh-Hant: {name}家裡聊到要不要有一個孩子。

text.en: The household does not change.
text.zh-Hant: 家庭不變。

text.en: The household grows by one; the home size and rent follow the household size.
text.zh-Hant: 家裡多一個人，房子大小和房租跟著家庭人數改變。
